# KeXinMaterials (客信新材料) — box.beeaa.com

> KeXinMaterials (Zhongshan Junzhijia) — source factory of protective cases, established 2014. 13,000㎡ facility, 60+ machines, 20+ patents, 150+ SKUs. Specializing in plastic tool boxes, protective cases, safety cases, waterproof cases — OEM/ODM custom. Exported to USA, UK, Germany, Canada, Japan, Russia, Philippines, India, HK/TW, Middle East.
> 公司: 中山市军之甲塑料制品有限公司 / Zhongshan Junzhijia Plastic Products Co., Ltd.
> 对外品牌: KeXinMaterials / 客信新材料
> 工厂: 13000㎡ · 100+ 员工 · 60+ 台先进制造设备 · 20+ 专利
> 主营: 塑料工具箱、安全防护箱、密封箱、防水防潮箱、五金工具箱、机械配件箱、零件盒
> 成立: 2014 年
> 联系: kexin@beeaa.com / +86 13590555309 (WhatsApp/WeChat)

## 网站架构 (Site Architecture)

依据 doc1.txt + a(1) V3.0 + a(2)，本目录采用 3-Tier 程序化 SEO + GEO + AI 引用架构：

- **Tier 1 头部词** (5 示例): /guides/ — 人工深度编辑 (2000+ 字)，含 Article Schema + author/date/citation
- **Tier 2 中长尾** (~12,877 词): /[product-line]/[keyword]/ — 模板 + 人工审核
- **Tier 3 长尾** (~18,438 词): /[product-line]/[keyword]-[no]/ — 程序化 (noindex 试投)
- **C 级** (173 词): 跳过不创建

## 9 大产品线 (9 Product Lines)

- [Military & Tactical Case](https://box.beeaa.com/military-tactical-case/) — 军工战术防护系列 — MIL-SPEC tactical cases, rifle cases, ammo cans, NVG cases. Export to 25+ countries.
- [Drone & Robotics Case](https://box.beeaa.com/drone-case/) — 无人机与机器人系列 — DJI / industrial / FPV / ROV / battery / RC cases. 200+ models fit.
- [Precision Instrument Case](https://box.beeaa.com/instrument-case/) — 精密仪器仪表系列 — Surveying / flaw detection / fusion splicer / endoscope / weather / medical instrument cases. 25G shock.
- [Waterproof Outdoor Case](https://box.beeaa.com/waterproof-case/) — 防水户外安全系列 — IP67/IP68 waterproof cases, outdoor, camping, fishing, drifting, expedition, off-road. -40~+120°C.
- [Medical & Cold Chain Case](https://box.beeaa.com/medical-case/) — 医疗急救冷链系列 — First aid / cold chain / nucleic acid / dental / UN3373 biological / WHO PQS.
- [Engineering Plastic Case](https://box.beeaa.com/engineering-plastic-case/) — 工程塑料工艺系列 — PP / ABS / glass fiber / FR / injection / rotomold / blow mold. NEV battery pack first choice.
- [Tool Box & Industrial Case](https://box.beeaa.com/tool-box/) — 工具箱工业周转系列 — Industrial tool box / turnover / hardware / maintenance / mining heavy-duty. 100kg+ load.
- [Camera & Stage Case](https://box.beeaa.com/camera-stage-case/) — 摄影数码舞台系列 — Camera / DSLR / stage lighting / entertainment. MIL-SPEC + aesthetic.
- [Trolley & Business Case](https://box.beeaa.com/trolley-case/) — 拉杆箱商务生活系列 — Business trolley / gift / display / cosmetic / business travel. 20/24/28 inch.

## 检测报告 (Test Reports)

- ISO9001:2015 Quality Management (ISO 9001:2015) — 2024-03-15 — Certified, valid until 2027-03
- ROHS EU Hazardous Substance (2011/65/EU + (EU) 2015/863) — 2024-08-20 — All 10 hazardous substances pass
- CE EU Safety Compliance (EN 60529 (IP Code)) — 2024-09-10 — LVD + EMC both pass
- SGS Third-Party Test (SGS-CSTC Standards) — 2024-06-30 — Material + process + performance all pass
- Series 8 IP67 Waterproof Level 7 (IEC 60529) — 2024-11-05 — 1m/30min immersion, zero leakage
- Series 8 Dustproof Level 6 (IEC 60529) — 2024-11-05 — Dust chamber 8hr, zero ingress
- Series 8 Compression Test (ASTM D642) — 2024-11-05 — 150kg load 24h, zero deformation
- California Proposition 65 (CA Prop 65) — 2024-07-15 — All 800+ chemicals below limits
